protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: textToHtml matched attacker-controlled raw text and interpolated link.url and link.text into HTML without escaping; a double quote in the URL could terminate href and inject an event-handler attribute. CVE-2026-3455 remains PUBLISHED, specifies mailparser <3.9.3, and maintainer andris9 stated that the claim was verified and fixed in v3.9.3.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: CONFIRMED: 7cba5bcfc2591088b02b238a495e4e741825205c first changed linkify.pretest/match from the fully HTML-encoded buffer to raw str while retaining the unescaped anchor interpolation. Earlier 8d544ffd8452bfae81b6e1fb22e78f488a843cc0 removed per-link encoding but still matched he.encode(str), so the quote was already neutralized and that earlier state did not contain this complete mechanism.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: CONFIRMED: the sole parent is 4e367f7fda2505b9edb8e195eb5b1a8e1d1531fc; it uses linkify.pretest(encoded) and linkify.match(encoded), and exact git grep finds no linkify.match(str). The complete exploitable mechanism is absent in the immediate parent, so primary field introducer_parent_absent=false is incorrect.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: CONFIRMED_NOT_APPLICABLE: 7cba5bcfc2591088b02b238a495e4e741825205c is a one-parent commit directly tagged v2.7.0. Its tree contains the first public raw-match change, and the local history exposes no finer member object to substitute for it.
protocol_checks.affected_fixed_release_membership: CONFIRMED: 7cba5bcfc2591088b02b238a495e4e741825205c is not an ancestor of v2.6.0, is the v2.7.0 commit, and is an ancestor of v3.9.2. Fix 921a67df4cfb38f0b411037d7b26fbd4d5411b08 is not in v3.9.2 and is in v3.9.3, matching the advisory boundary <3.9.3.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_verified_unpatched_state: CONFIRMED: 921a67df4cfb38f0b411037d7b26fbd4d5411b08 directly replaces raw link.url/link.text interpolation with double-quote escaping for the URL and he.encode for link text, and adds issue-412 regression tests. The v3.9.2..v3.9.3 range contains that functional fix followed by the release commit.
protocol_checks.bic_only_ai_attribution: CONFIRMED: the BIC commit object is authored and committed by Andris Reinman <andris@kreata.ee> on 2019-05-01, message v2.7.0, with no trailers or AI marker. Later AI-related repository activity and the 2026 fix are not used for attribution; NOT_AI is supported for this real vulnerability.

findings: The primary causal verdict NOT_AI and all cited full SHAs are supported by the independent clone and advisory replay.

The structured field introducer_parent_absent is internally inconsistent with the primary evidence and independently verified parent tree: the complete raw-match-plus-unescaped-interpolation mechanism is absent in the immediate parent.
